commands.name: nexus_capture_game_view
commands.description: Captures Game View Overlay or a Scene View framed on a target. JPEG by default, longest edge 768 unless raised.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Target width in pixels (0 for native Game View width).

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Target height in pixels (0 for native Game View height).

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Image encoding format: 'jpg' (default) or 'png'. Only one encoding is returned.

parameters.name: max_dimension
parameters.description: Longest edge in pixels. Defaults to 768. Pass 1024 to opt in. 0 keeps the source size up to 8192.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: game (default) or scene. Scene View is framed on the target.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Hierarchy path or unique object name to crop or frame.

parameters.name: instance_id
parameters.description: Unity instance id to crop or frame, including a negative scene-object id. Zero means none. Do not also pass target.

parameters.name: delivery
parameters.description: base64 (default) or file. File writes one image under Temp and omits base64.

parameters.name: request_id
parameters.description: Optional string copied into meta.request_id. It is not stored.
